title: AquaVoid
description: We are a new Minecraft server themed around the theme of Anarchy, "AquaVoid," with a pure concept. Minimal plugins, just classic anarchy in its purest form.
body: We are a new Minecraft server themed around the theme of Anarchy, "AquaVoid," with a pure concept. Minimal plugins, just classic anarchy in its purest form. Donations have virtually no impact on gameplay—no pay-to-win. 7 events will be added with new wipes. Behold the new anarchy!
